basics.name: Gursidak Singh Grover
basics.label: Software Engineering Student · SWE Intern at SensTek Diagnostics · Co-Founder & CTO, Redstone Automations
basics.summary: Second-year Software Engineering student at York University's Lassonde School of Engineering. Software Engineering Intern at SensTek Diagnostics and Co-Founder & CTO of Redstone Automations (formerly AIVAA), building AI agents, websites and integrations for local businesses. Long-term goal: work at NVIDIA. Seeking a Software Engineering internship for Summer 2027.

work.name: SensTek Diagnostics
highlights: Architected and deployed a full-stack proposal (Django/DRF, React, React Native) that became SensTek's build roadmap
Connected lab equipment activity to the web app by building Python tracking scripts and a MySQL database
Cut pull request review time by 30% by building an automated dependency-graph visualizer and PR-commenting bot
Redesigned senstekdx.com's landing page to improve visitor click-through, benchmarking 9 industry competitors

work.name: Redstone Automations
highlights: Co-founded Redstone Automations, building voice AI receptionists, websites and agentic workflows for local businesses
Served as the main forward-deployed engineer, building AI voice agents with custom knowledge bases tied to client calendars
Engineer multi-step LLM tool calling into client APIs, CRMs, and email, validating outputs with RAG and guardrails
Own the full sales cycle for about 15 active customers, from cold outreach and discovery through closing

Gathered dietitian requirements and wrote feature specs, improving practitioner efficiency by 10%
Piloted the app with 100+ patients and practitioners at the clinic
Co-organize tech events and networking sessions
Support day-to-day club operations
